The primal–dual frontier

The comparison uses the full continuous, real, even L1(R) CMS class with genuine Fourier transform F^(t)=∫RF(x)e−2πixtdx. The positive exterior leakage must be integrable, and the denominator below must be positive. Integrability of the entire Fourier transform is not assumed.

QA(F)=‖F‖1F(0)−A∫|t|>1max(0,F^(t))dt,A=3611

Abel-regularized Fourier inversion proves weak duality under the full stated CMS conditions, without an additional Fourier-integrability premise. A nonnegative combination of the same window budgets retains a common obstruction; that argument does not exclude genuinely different RH reductions. CMS(1.3), (1.12)–(1.14).

The finite norm uses131,072 FFT nodes; the whole-ray witness uses16,777,216. The original affine data, meshes, signs, upward rounding and outputs are fixed. In particular the support-seven witness is not normalized by silently replacing its actual F(0) with1.

Write the even affine window as the linear interpolation of its exact nodes W(j/m)=a|j|, with aN=0 and zero outside its support. The notation is fixed by:

P(t)=a0+2∑j=1N−1ajcos(2πjt),sinc(t)=sin(πt)πt,sinc(0)=1
F(u)=m−1sinc2(u/m)P(u/m),‖F‖1=∫01|P(y)|dy

BR v2 Lemma 5, Eq (4), p3 states the displayed identity at support radius 5. The formal extension for the actual radius 7 data uses proved dilation and a mesh change from 360 to 504. The entire/strip, derivative variation, prime-power, wing and endpoint estimates are proved for the actual finite affine window. A new support-seven source axiom is not introduced.

A closed analytic gap

The earlier general weighted-zero rule was broader than the test-function specialization printed after CMS Lemma 9. It is now an ordinary Lean theorem, consumed by the final prime theorems. The published zero-count estimate remains an explicit input; the extension is proved rather than attributed to an unprinted universal source theorem.

Here the zeros are the actual nontrivial zeta zeros, counted with multiplicity.

The proved declaration is cms_zero_partial_summation_kernel; its exact canonical correspondence is CMSExplicitInputs.v1.zero_partial_summation. The printed calculation selects a particular test function. Applying that display to every even differentiable function satisfying the stated tail conditions was the extra obligation:

F(x)=H(x/λ),H(x)=cos(2πx)1−16x2(removable values at x=±1/4)
N(T)=∑0<γ≤Tmult(γ),Q(T)=T2πlogT2πe+78,|N(T)−Q(T)|≤0.15logT+3 (T≥e)

CMS §6.1, Lemma9 and following display, pp23–24. The proof uses the actual right-closed count, derives countable support and summability, and performs finite-cutoff FTC/Fubini before taking any infinite limit. It proves the auxiliary zero of the displayed counting main term Q(T) and handles the negative-ordinate and real-zero contributions.

gε(t)=F(t)2+ε2,|gε′(t)|≤|F′(t)|,0≤gε(t)−|F(t)|≤ε

Smooth modulus approximation avoids assuming that the absolute value of a differentiable function is differentiable at its zeros. The smoothing parameter tends to zero at fixed cutoff first; the cutoff then tends to infinity. Complex zeta conjugation and multiplicity preservation supply the negative-ordinate reindexing. These are mathematical proofs, not numerical checks.

The signed logarithmic moment keeps its negative central contribution at τ=3/8. The middle contribution on [τ,1] is nonpositive; the positive tail is bounded by derivative variation. This is sign information in the density correction, not cancellation between different complex zeros. The finite slab uses Montgomery–Vaughan block choice16, the ray uses1, and both retain the original0.0012 error reserve.

Concavity and endpoint inequalities control the complete log slab; monotonicity controls the infinite ray. Bounds on actual prime counts leave room to discard a possible upper-endpoint prime. Direct cases at4,5,7,11 and the historical CMS (1.15) finite gap input bridge the small range; the latter is explicitly literature/computation-backed, not reverified by a new giant prime search.

The exact whole-ray witness uses the original2520 scaled integer coefficients, an appended zero endpoint and even affine interpolation. Its data are the original W4 JSON; the mesh is m=360 and the support is [−7,7]. In particular its value at zero is not silently normalized to one:

F(0)=3599999999999999998360·1016=1−11800000000000000000<1

The denominator, source-derived scalar output and rational-to-real bridge are checked separately. The same2521 nodes at mesh504 belong to the printed radius-five class; the proved dilation 504/360=7/5 transfers its analytic strip and norm statements to the actual radius-seven function. No unprinted “support-seven source theorem” is assumed.

Actual C source-first verification

Here “PV” means source-first program verification: actual external source text, an independently specified restricted syntax, execution correctness, the numerical mathematical specification, and real consumption by the ANT theorem. A kernel-only trace certificate or physical execution alone is not PV.

C source ⟶ independent syntax/AST ⟶ actual modeled main ⟶ output and integral bound ⟶ prime theorem

The selected programs are the actual recursive C ports fap_fft_recursive.c and w4_fft_recursive.c. They implement a mathematically equivalent recursive traversal of the original fixed-point FFT. Verification concerns those C bytes, not the original Python bytes; numerical and ANT completion is recorded separately for each result above. The legacy iterative C ports remain separate artifacts.

The C arithmetic uses scale 1036 in base 109 limbs; the original Python twiddle engine used scale 1030. Their proved rounding and integral enclosures support the original numerical cap. Agreement of two Python evaluators sharing that engine is not used as independent verification of it.

The real-prime count is represented by a natural floor, and natural subtraction is monotone in the eventual positive domain, giving the actual half-open count. Neither membership at the infimum coefficient nor any earlier finite onset is asserted.

The published analytic or historical proof remains an explicit mathematical hypothesis.

No material source-to-contract mismatch was found in the audited input families. The CMS weighted-zero partial-summation obligation used in this RH proof is now discharged. Historical direct computations remain literature-backed. Metadata fingerprints and local canonical checks are not official Comparator approval receipts.

The Montgomery–Vaughan entrance allowance, derived term by term

The actual original statement is Montgomery–Vaughan, Theorem2, Eq(1.12), printed p121/PDF p3. Its real parameters satisfy M>0, N>1. The formal contract uses the narrower domain a>1, y>1.

π(M+N)−π(M)≤2NlogN

The derived Lean declaration is mv_interval_entrance_bound. Its Blueprint input correspondence is CMSExplicitInputs.v1.montgomery_vaughan. For a>1, a≤b, ℓ>1, y=b−a+ℓ, each additional term follows explicitly:

#{p prime:a<p≤b}≤π(a+y)−π(a)
π(a+y)−π(a)≤2y/logy
y≥ℓ>1 ⟹ 2y/logy≤2y/logℓ
2y/logℓ=2(b−a)/logℓ+2ℓ/logℓ

Thus 2ℓ/logℓ is the enlarged-interval entrance allowance. The later atomic/bounded-variation proof supplies the nodal variation factor separately; it is not an unexplained source constant.

How IEANTN propagates the result

Canonical evolution adds proved zero-summation and source-linked Fourier-norm providers while preserving old nodes and the original prime statements. A theorem consumer receives propositions through named dependencies; a new provider must prove precisely those propositions. Exact interface bridges and separate Solution builds check this correspondence. The source-linked norm provider and newly proved zero transfer are actually traversed in the final proof-value audit.

The four new node versions expose29 conclusions, including retained aliases and related consequences; these are not29 independent discoveries. The1,035-module N24 proof bank mostly packages the generated numerical trace in manageable chunks. The successful aggregation repair adds two generic helper modules and changes two proof bodies. This campaign verifies its selected numerical programs and consumers; it does not attempt to complete every numerical program or statement stub in IEANTN.

All29 local proof interfaces passed in normal, −O and −OO modes, with38 audited proof roots and eight isolated Challenge/Solution routes. Registry metadata records awaiting-verification and lean-noncompliant: complete local Lean proofs without official Comparator receipts. The ordinary workflow has not been validated for each standalone Solution. These labels describe workflow status; no forbidden axiom or failed mathematical theorem is being concealed.

The norm proposition can be reused by several consumers. Here it supplies the global interval and weighted population proofs; the finite and whole-ray providers compose into the piecewise theorem. The analytic flat family supplies another population provider without a numerical program, and the hybrid frontier selects an attained good coefficient. The graph records these alternatives and their assumptions. New proofs were still required for the general zero transfer, support dilation, continuous margins and C execution refinement; adding a node did not automatically invent those arguments.

Resource admission checked RAM and disk separately. Runs could use up to 300 GiB memory when at least 1 TiB RAM was actually available; scratch had its independent 300 GiB cap. The original mathematical supervisor stopped at290GiB; the later generic bootstrap, comparison and native-build guards used288GiB, with their initial-allocation and selected-workspace reservations recorded explicitly. Whole-campaign unique storage accounting remains authoritative, including fresh outputs outside a selected logs directory. Host reserve, process limits and live telemetry were recorded. Sampled group memory observations are lower bounds for the peak of their stated metric, not exact high-water marks.

Per-process RSS, sums of process RSS and owned-cgroup memory.current are different metrics. Process sums can count shared mappings more than once. Each receipt identifies its metric; sampled maxima are lower bounds for that same metric’s peak. Exact physical cgroup peaks were unavailable on this host. Directory-accounted disk allocation is distinguished from sampled whole-campaign scratch and unique storage shared through hardlinks. OOM counts are called measured only when applicable owned memory.events counters were retained; a historical controller literal0 is explicitly corrected to unknown.

The first681-module finite replay failed because34 CSV loader inputs were omitted; the versioned data-aware replay includes exact paths, widths, counts, bytes and hashes. Later finite and N24 runs reached the total campaign scratch reserve and were stopped, with owned OOM counters zero. Their successful same-experiment source-cold prefixes were independently validated and resumed. Reused and fresh module counts are reported separately; a continuation is not described as one monolithic fresh run. Virtual address-space ceilings are separate from aggregate physical-memory limits. Every original failed or stopped outcome is retained.

The N24 final aggregation first failed under a256GiB virtual-address ceiling while the owned300GiB physical cgroup recorded no OOM or kill. An unlimited-address retry then spent most CPU time in memory management and was deliberately stopped; its actual compiler receipt143 and absent proof object are authoritative, even though GNU time printed an exit-status0 field after signal termination. The later process-only resource profile disables transparent huge pages before the supervisor and all children, and verifies actual CPU affinity. It changes no numerical source, data, theorem or checker and makes no host-global setting change. Huge-page compaction as the earlier cause is an inference, not a controlled causal result. A pre-exec policy receipt establishes process configuration, never proof acceptance. See exact resource profile.

That separate THP-disabled source-identical retry actually reached the physical300GiB limit: its completed counters record one OOM and one OOM kill. Its empty GNU-time output does not supply a final compiler peak. The successful next route changes two Lean aggregation proof bodies, using general symbolic fold and norm identities instead of reducing the entire16,777,216-element output at the final step. That later hash does not prove the original run-time helper identity. Research exposition and limitations

The study connects original source programs to conditional prime theorems through independently specified syntax, actual modeled execution, exact arithmetic and analytic transfer. Its main advance is the closed proof chain and reuse of stronger numerical information; source verification alone does not improve an already established coefficient. The new Gaussian and population witnesses give separate mathematical improvements. The full-class dual obstruction explains why the fixed CMS functional cannot reach0.8.

Negative results matter: no proved sub0.8 eventual reduction; no optimality theorem; stronger dual numerical proposals remain outside Lean; finite and eventual onsets cannot be exchanged; sparse controlled trials establish no general exposure advantage. The finite historical computation, named literature inputs and precise platform contracts remain visible assumptions.

한국어 수학 요약

이 연구는 RH를 가정한 소수 간격·소수 개수 정리와 실제 C 프로그램의 검증을 연결합니다. RH 자체를 증명한 것은 아닙니다. 논문에서 가져온 해석적 명제와 과거 유한 계산은 이름을 붙인 가정으로 남겨 두었습니다.

새로운 핵심은 실제 소스, 독립적인 구문 관계, 실행 의미론, 정수 계산, 적분 경계, 최종 소수 정리를 한 증명 경로로 연결한 것입니다. 일반화된 영점 부분합 공식은 별도 가정에서 Lean 정리로 바뀌었습니다. 프로그램 검증만으로 이미 알려진 계수가 자동으로 좋아진다는 주장은 하지 않습니다.

점근적 가우스 계수는 2058256129624680948495<0.833945313이며 구체적인 시작점은 없습니다. 유한 구간의0.8,0.74,0.75와 전체 구간의0.851062는 보고서 표에 적힌 실제 검증 상태·범위·가정을 따라 읽어야 합니다. 수치로 확인한 더 강한 쌍대 경계와 Lean으로 증명한 경계도 구별했습니다.

별도의 해석적 개선으로 모든 양의 정수 매개변수에 대한 평탄 스펙트럼 계열을 Lean으로 증명했습니다. 이 결과는 수치 프로그램 검증을 쓰지 않습니다. 특히 밀도40에서 폭 53867/1270≈42.414960630을 얻어, Lee 정리에서 직접 유도한 비교값 약42.737908384보다 작습니다. 일반 계열의 경곗값에서는 하한집합의 infimum만 보장하며, 실제 소수 개수 정리에는 양의 여유가 필요합니다.

더 나아가 충분히 큰 모든 실수 밀도에 대해 α+(logα)/π+(2+log(2π))/π+η의 폭을 증명했습니다. 여기서 η>0이며 상수는 약1.221634입니다. 밀도를 먼저 고정한 뒤 소수 변수의 시작점을 정합니다. 두 변수를 동시에 제어하는 명시적 시작점이나 최적성은 주장하지 않습니다.

노출 실험16개의 원래 판정은 보존했습니다. 제한에 걸린13개를 나중에 검증했다고 원래 성공으로 바꾸지 않았습니다. 각 실험의 수학적 결과와 추가 가정을 따로 비교하며, 이 작은 표본으로 네트워크나 PV의 전반적 우월성을 주장하지 않습니다.

별도의 저장소 검사에서는 23개 명령 중 17개가 통과하고 6개가 실패했습니다. 네이티브 빌드와 지문 생성은 성공했지만, 기존 상위 저장소의 검증 영수증과 현재 작업 사본의 저장소 식별 정보가 달라 영수증 검사와 종합 검사가 각 실행 모드에서 실패했습니다. 이 실패를 성공으로 바꾸거나 기존 영수증·검사기를 수정하지 않았습니다. 완료된 로컬 수학 증명과 공식 노드 승인은 구분해야 합니다.
